purpose: Names of absorbed external providers that must never appear as active/callable references in installed Chohogi assets. doctor.py reads this file and fails conformance when a marker is found under the installed Chohogi tree, outside the files that declare the deny rule itself. This does not remove a marker by itself; it only turns an undetected regression into a reported one.

markers.reason: The writing-plans/executing-plans/subagent-driven-development pattern is absorbed. Its generated plan documents contain a self-propagating 'REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: superpowers:...' directive that re-invokes the same external provider when the document is later read; this directive must not be honored regardless of where it is found.
